CHAITANYA VADREW

Capital Markets Business Analyst | Trade Lifecycle | Calypso Platform | Regulatory & Operations Transformation

9736193719 • cvadrew@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Capital Markets Business Analyst with 8+ years translating complex front-to-back trade lifecycle requirements into scalable Calypso-based and multi-platform technology solutions across Investment Banking, Wealth Management, and Custody operations. Functional expertise spanning Fixed Income, Credit Derivatives (CDS, CLNs), Interest Rate Derivatives (IRS, Swaptions), FX Options, Commodity Derivatives, and Equity Derivatives, covering the complete trade lifecycle from order management and Front Office Workstation (FOWS) through Calypso WorkStation (CWS), Middle Office, Back Office settlement, reconciliation, NAV, and regulatory reporting. Hands-on exposure to Calypso Trading Platform architecture, pricing environments, pricer configuration, and workflow/engine customization. Proven delivery of BRD/FRD-driven, UAT-validated production releases using Agile and Waterfall methodologies, with measurable STP rate improvements, settlement break reductions, and zero post-deployment rollbacks.

CORE COMPETENCIES & ATS KEYWORDS

Platform

Calypso Trading Platform, Calypso Architecture, Calypso WorkStation (CWS), Front Office Workstation (FOWS), Calypso ERS Module

Calypso Modules

Pricing Environments, Pricers, Pricer Measures (Standard & Custom), Messaging, Accounting, Message Matching, Scheduled Tasks, Workflows, Engines, Calypso Customization

Asset Classes

Fixed Income, Credit Derivatives (CDS, CLNs), Interest Rate Derivatives (IRS, Swaptions), FX Options, FX Forwards, Commodity Derivatives, Equity Derivatives, Structured Notes, Exchange-Traded & OTC

Trade Lifecycle

Order Mgmt, Execution, Trade Booking, Settlement, STP, Reconciliation, Corporate Actions, NAV, Regulatory Reporting, Production Release & Deployment

BA Artefacts

BRD, FRD, User Stories, Process Flows, UAT Test Plans, Defect Management, Traceability Matrix, Business Case Documentation

Methodologies

Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Waterfall, SDLC, Change Management, Stakeholder Management, Root Cause Analysis

Operations

Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Custody, Counterparty Management, Regulatory Compliance, ERISA & IRS

Tools

MS Excel (Advanced), JIRA, Confluence, SQL (Basic), Data Reconciliation, Process Mapping, KPI Dashboards

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lead Business Analyst | Standard Chartered Global Business Pvt Ltd Capital Markets | Trade Lifecycle | Settlement | NAV | Corporate Actions | Equity & Fixed Income

Aug 2024 – May 2026

Drove Calypso platform requirements for trade booking, price injection, and settlement exception workflows, collaborated with the Calypso implementation team to translate business requirements into Calypso-compatible functional specifications covering Messaging, Accounting, Scheduled Tasks, and Workflow engine configurations, reducing manual processing steps by 40%.

Reduced settlement breaks by 30% by leading end-to-end requirements gathering for exception management enhancements across equity and fixed income booking, custody confirmation, and reconciliation workflows, directly improving STP rates across European trading desks.

Delivered 4 BRD/FRD production releases on schedule covering NAV calculation, dividend processing, price injection, and expense allocation workflows, coordinating sign-off across Front Office, Operations, Data Valuation, Regulatory, and Custody stakeholders; supported software deployment and post-release validation into production environments.

Accelerated UAT cycle time by 25% by defining 200+ structured test scenarios and acceptance criteria for NAV publication, Calypso pricing environment validations, and settlement exception handling, enabling QA teams to execute end-to-end trade lifecycle validation with zero production rollbacks.

•

Improved corporate action processing accuracy by 40% through gap analysis of STP workflows in Calypso; proposed and implemented automation controls that eliminated manual overrides for dividend elections and mandatory events, directly raising straight-through processing rates.

Acted as primary liaison between Calypso technical teams, operations, and front office users for pricing discrepancy resolution — conducting root cause analysis workshops that cut recurring reconciliation exceptions by 35% and informed pricer measure reconfiguration.

Associate Business Analyst | Voya India Pvt Ltd Wealth Management | 401(k) Retirement Operations | Compliance Reporting | ERISA / IRS Regulatory Workflows

Dec 2019 – Aug 2024

Cut reconciliation break resolution time by 45% by designing process controls and automated exception flagging for distributions, loans, RMDs, and rollovers — reducing operational risk exposure across $2B+ AUM portfolio.

Delivered 6 ERISA/IRS-compliant BRDs for plan fee calculations, P&L reporting, and distribution processing enhancements — achieving 100% audit pass rate across two successive regulatory reviews.

Led 12 UAT cycles end-to-end — defining test objectives, validating system changes, and securing business sign-off —



resulting in zero post-production compliance defects across regulatory reporting modules. Improved SLA adherence from 84% to 97% by authoring business case documentation for transaction processing automation, quantifying impact on accuracy and compliance for executive sign-off.

Reduced data mismatch incidents by 50% through detailed root cause analysis on reconciliation breaks and data exceptions — driving permanent fixes across loan processing and compliance reporting pipelines.

Managed cross-functional requirements sessions between Operations, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams, translating complex IRS regulatory mandates into clear, actionable functional specifications.

Transaction Processing Analyst | Mphasis Pvt Ltd Trade Settlement | Equities & Fixed Income | US Markets | Custody Operations

Aug 2018 – Nov 2019



Improved settlement accuracy by 28% by analyzing trade lifecycle breaks across equities, vanilla interest rate swaps, FX forwards, and fixed income instruments — authoring functional specifications for settlement exception management, trade matching, and custody confirmation enhancements aligned with Calypso-based settlement workflows.

Defined UAT scenarios for production release validation covering custody confirmation, settlement failure resolution, and reconciliation workflows — enabling QA to sign off end-to-end test cycles and reducing counterparty dispute rate by 20% within six months of deployment.

Supported software deployment into production and maintained audit packs and regulatory reports across US market trade settlement operations, achieving 100% documentation compliance across quarterly audit cycles.

Process Analyst | Genpact Pvt Ltd Trade Booking | Confirmation | Process Mapping

Apr 2017 – Aug 2018

Reduced trade booking TAT by 20% by documenting and optimising business rules for trade booking/confirmation workflows — identified 8 process redundancies eliminated through structured process mapping exercises.

PROJECTS

Secure Invest — Centralized Transaction Management Application

Led requirements and delivery of a centralized transaction tracking system with role-based access controls, automated approval workflows, and multi-format reporting (Excel, PDF, text). Supported .xlsb file ingestion and manager-level transaction governance — reducing review cycle time by 30%.

Matrix Repositories — Cloud-Based Check Storage & Audit System

Defined requirements for a cloud-based secure document storage system with role-based retrieval and multi-parameter search (account number, check number, date). Delivered enhanced audit traceability and reduced document retrieval time by 60%.

Investor Communication Channel — Automated Investor Statement & Reporting Platform

Led end-to-end BA delivery of an investor communications platform that automated personalised statement generation for all bank investors based on their communication subscription preferences (frequency, channel, format). Gathered functional requirements covering investor data ingestion, NAV feed integration, portfolio holdings data mapping, cash balance reconciliation, and regulatory content standards — authoring BRDs and FRDs defining statement template logic, data segregation rules, and investor-level entitlements.

Defined 150+ UAT test scenarios to validate fund value accuracy, NAV alignment, portfolio data completeness, and investor-level data segregation across all statement types — collaborating with Data, Operations, Custody, and Technology teams to ensure reconciled data feeds published within SLA.

• Reduced manual statement preparation effort by 60% and eliminated distribution errors by driving automation of the end- to-end statement generation and dispatch workflow; achieved 100% on-time delivery across all investor communication subscription types using Agile delivery methodology.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Commerce (B. Com) | Krishna University

2014 – 2017

ACHIEVEMENTS & RECOGNITION

Received client appreciation and internal awards for delivering multiple high-impact projects simultaneously on schedule — recognized for stakeholder management excellence and operational delivery quality.

Successfully managed concurrent delivery of 4+ major trade lifecycle enhancement projects, each with independent regulatory and business milestones, without schedule overruns.

PROJECTS
Secure Invest — Centralized Transaction Management Application
Led requirements and delivery of a centralized transaction tracking system with role-based access controls, automated approval workflows, and multi-format reporting (Excel, PDF, text). Supported .xlsb file ingestion and manager-level transaction governance — reducing review cycle time by 30%.
Matrix Repositories — Cloud-Based Check Storage & Audit System
Defined requirements for a cloud-based secure document storage system with role-based retrieval and multi-parameter search (account number, check number, date). Delivered enhanced audit traceability and reduced document retrieval time by 60%.
Investor Communication Channel — Automated Investor Statement & Reporting Platform
Led end-to-end BA delivery of an investor communications platform that automated personalised statement generation for all bank investors based on their communication subscription preferences (frequency, channel, format). Gathered functional requirements covering investor data ingestion, NAV feed integration, portfolio holdings data mapping, cash balance reconciliation, and regulatory content standards — authoring BRDs and FRDs defining statement template logic, data segregation rules, and investor-level entitlements.
Defined 150+ UAT test scenarios to validate fund value accuracy, NAV alignment, portfolio data completeness, and investor-level data segregation across all statement types — collaborating with Data, Operations, Custody, and Technology teams to ensure reconciled data feeds published within SLA.
• Reduced manual statement preparation effort by 60% and eliminated distribution errors by driving automation of the end- to-end statement generation and dispatch workflow; achieved 100% on-time delivery across all investor communication subscription types using Agile delivery methodology.
